vendor.method: shadcn CLI 4.23.0 output for the base-luma style (components.json `style: base-luma`, `rtl: true`; `npx shadcn@4.23.0 add <name> --dry-run --view`) (MIT), migrated to @base-ui/react and @ui-sdk/react primitives
changes: `cn` is imported from `@/lib/utils` (it knows the five type steps), not the CLI's `cn` package
All interactive primitives are backed by @base-ui/react or @ui-sdk/react (no Radix dependencies or CSS variables)

Type steps and weights of DESIGN.md section 8 (text-sm and text-xs become text-body and text-meta; 400 except where 500 is allowed), the 2px --ring focus outline in place of Luma's translucent ring, 44px targets below 640px
shadcn.css holds Base UI / UI SDK keyframes, state variants and the no-scrollbar utility

index.css carries the Norn theme tokens: luma (Luma's radius scale with the monochrome greys measured from Polar and getopen.so, R = G = B, DESIGN.md 19.6), and the polar, open and glass skins, and base layer

Luma's geometry (pill buttons, toggles and tabs, rounded-3xl popovers and menus, rounded-4xl cards and dialogs) reaches the components through Norn's tokens (--radius-*, --radius-step-*); inputs, textareas and field groups are white 1px-hairline fields at --radius / --radius-composer (12-14px), not Luma's filled pills (DESIGN.md 19.6)

message, bubble and trace (shadcn's chat primitives) carry the type steps, logical inline classes and the 2px --ring focus outline; Sidekick draws the person's words in a muted Bubble and each tool call as a Trace
